dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, jagged perimeters with a sharp gradient transition from high-intensity (white) outer borders to low-intensity (dark grey) interiors. The most prominent dorsal annuli exhibit a scalloped or frilled geometry along their high-contrast boundaries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of solid clusters. High-intensity pixels are primarily concentrated into thin, curvilinear structures forming the annuli perimeters rather than solid blobs. Small, isolated high-intensity pixel clusters are visible along the lower-left lateral margin.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four largest dorsal annuli form an elongated, irregular quadrilateral. The spatial arrangement of these features suggests a non-uniform tessellation across the mid-dorsal surface.

other_distinctive_markers: The texture forms a continuous, interlocking network of high-contrast white lines across the dorsal-lateral surface, creating a honeycomb or reticulated visual effect.
